name: Conversation Trace
description: Structured trace of a conversation flow through the RAG pipeline and LLM processing stages.

properties.name: conversation_id
properties.description: Unique identifier for the conversation being traced

properties.name: tracing_enabled
properties.description: Whether tracing is active for this conversation

properties.name: user_message
properties.description: Original user message that started the conversation

properties.name: target_llm
properties.description: Target LLM for the conversation (openai, gemini, ollama)
